_comment: Corresponding source for the GPL-licensed binaries this application redistributes, staged into the release by Scripts/Fetch-CorrespondingSource.ps1. GPL-2.0 section 3 accepts three routes; this is route (a), accompanying the binary with the source, which is why THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt makes no written offer and names no contact point. Every entry is pinned by SHA-256 and every version below was read from VLC's own contrib/src/<name>/rules.mak inside the VLC tarball, not chosen by hand.

correspondsTo.versionCheck: libvlc.dll FileVersion in the restored package must equal upstreamVersion. The NuGet package version (3.0.23.1) differs from the upstream release it carries (3.0.23), so the binary is the authority. A mismatch means the cached source no longer corresponds to the shipped binaries, and the publish fails rather than shipping source for a different build.

components.name: VLC
components.sha256Source: Published by VideoLAN on its own download page for this file, and verified against the downloaded copy.
components.describes: libvlc.dll, libvlccore.dll and the plugin modules under libvlc/win-x64/plugins/, including the VLC-side sources of libavcodec_plugin.dll and libswscale_plugin.dll. Its contrib/src/<name>/rules.mak files are what pin the versions of the components below.

components.name: FFmpeg
components.describes: libavcodec and libswscale, which are compiled into libavcodec_plugin.dll and libswscale_plugin.dll. VLC pins FFmpeg by commit rather than by release tarball (contrib/src/ffmpeg/rules.mak sets FFMPEG_HASH), so this is that exact commit; the shipped binaries report libavcodec 58.134.100, which is the 4.4 series.

components.name: LAME
components.describes: Statically linked into libavcodec_plugin.dll (FFmpeg built with libmp3lame enabled). LAME is LGPL, and it is linked statically rather than shipped as its own DLL, so this source is how the relink provision of LGPL section 6 is met for it.

components.name: OpenJPEG
components.describes: Statically linked into libavcodec_plugin.dll (FFmpeg built with libopenjpeg enabled). BSD-2-Clause.

components.name: libgsm
components.describes: Statically linked into libavcodec_plugin.dll (FFmpeg built with libgsm enabled). Permissive licence, Technische Universitaet Berlin. The URL VLC's contrib pins (libgsm.sourcearchive.com) no longer resolves; this is the upstream author's own site, and the archive is pinned by hash so the substitution is verifiable rather than trusted.
